description: Normative statements of spec/formatting.md that the WG suite does not test: mf2-two's own tests, written from the spec in the suite's schema (plans/01-conformance.md §5; conformance/COVERAGE.md names the statement each covers).

tests.description: [F1] A custom function's resolved value as an option value (formatting.md, Function Handler): a :test:function value used as an option value is its Input (test/README.md), so decimalPlaces is 1.
[F2] A built-in function's resolved value as an option value: a :number value is a digit size option.
[F3] Markup resolution always succeeds (formatting.md, Markup Resolution): an option whose variable is unresolved is left out, with Bad Option, and the markup is still there.
[F4] Option resolution errors are not fatal (formatting.md, Option Resolution): the unresolved option is left out and the expression formats without it.
[F5a] The order of options is not significant (formatting.md, Option Resolution); with F5b.
[F5b] The same options in the other order format the same (F5a).
[F6] A function's result is not a literal option value (formatting.md, Function Resolution): select set from a :string value is a Bad Option.
[F7] An attribute is not an option (formatting.md, Formatting): one named like a :number option changes nothing.
[F8] An attribute never reaches the function handler: @fails=format does not make :test:function fail.
